skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand concepts of system, information system, system development lifecycle, team and tools for system development, software development process, Unified Modeling Language (UML)
Apply methods for surveying, collecting, synthesizing requirements, proposing solutions for system development, and planning projects
Model business processes and functional requirements, structure through class diagrams, behavior through sequence and communication diagrams
Design overall architecture using package, component, and deployment diagrams, user interface design with Figma, detailed design of layers
Analyze and solve problems related to system analysis and design
Work effectively in teams to solve complex problems
Develop independent problem-solving abilities and social responsibility awareness
Effectively present findings and solutions in group settings
Continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies
Proficiently use Unified Modeling Language (UML) for modeling systems
Use Figma for designing user interfaces
